title: Which corner can rule out a row?
hook: Two ordered directions give one cell a useful choice.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Eliminate a row or column from a matrix whose rows and columns are sorted.

misconception: A row-sorted and column-sorted matrix can be treated as one sorted list.
objective: Eliminate a row or column from a matrix whose rows and columns are sorted.

claims.text: A value above the target eliminates its column; a value below eliminates its row. Each move removes impossible cells while retaining the target whenever it exists.
